text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 page: multiple GPU containers in cluster 'prod-eu' entering CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-23. Service: redwood-runtime. Estimated impact: degraded responses for some customers. Paging Ana (on-call).
Ana: acked. I'm on it. pulling logs now.
Ana: quick snapshot from kube: `kubectl -n inference logs redwood-runtime-7f9bb4-gpu-23 -c runtime --tail=200`
Ana: logs show multiple 'SIGSEGV' and 'segfault at 0 ip ...' in the fused-kernel library. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] runtime | ERROR: segfault (signal 11) at 0x7f8b2c3d
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] runtime | backtrace: 0x55aaf1... fused_kernel.so(+0x1a2b3)
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] runtime | model shard 3 process exited, restarting
```
Ana: crash loop count ~ 45 restarts in last 10m on that pod. container restarts ~ every 13s.
Raj: fyi - gpu-23 was on driver 525.89; we've seen issues with that driver + TRT fused kernels before. Could be a kernel/kernel-driver mismatch or bad quantized op.
Mia: customer impact: monitoring shows elevated 5xxs for customer-ids: cust_omega, cust-beta, cust-infra. Roughly 320 failed requests in last 5m, mostly generation endpoints.
Jamal: trying to replicate on staging? staging nodes have different driver (525.60) so might not reproduce. We should isolate node in prod.
Ana: plan: 1) cordon gpu-23 2) scale up spare pool and drain pods to other nodes 3) set runtime route fallback to model-variant-lowperf 4) if that fails, rollout immediate rollback of fused-kernel image to previous tag.
Ana: cordon + drain now. running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-23
kubectl drain gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
incident-bot: Node cordon/drain started by Ana.
Jamal: started a temporary autoscale to bring 3 spare GPUs into pool:
```
kubectl scale deployment/redwood-runtime-spare -n inference --replicas=3
```
Raj: before draining, can we set a route rule to avoid routing new requests to pods on gpu-23? we have service with sessionAffinity off, so drain should be enough but add a routing policy temporarily:
```
POST /admin/routes
{ "service":"redwood-runtime","policy":"avoid_node:gpu-23" }
```
Mia: telling Support to open a customer notification for cust_omega and cust-beta. ETA for next update 10m. tagging severity P1.
Ana: after drain started, observed fewer restarts on new pods but one other node (gpu-17) got a crash too — possible bad model variant or bad kernel in image. logs from new pod show same stack.
Ana: stack trace (more detailed):
```
#0  0x00007f8b2c3d in fused_conv_forward() at fused_kernel.cpp:452
#1  0x000055aaf1cdf in run_layer at runtime_executor.cpp:133
#2  0x000055aaf1d2e in forward at model_shard.cpp:78
#3  0x000055aaf1e9f in handle_request at server.cpp:421
```
Raj: that points to fused_conv. Could be bad input size or a race in kernel. Quick mitigation: rollback runtime image to v1.4.2 (last known good) and pin model routing to cpu-fallback temporarily.
Jamal: performing rollback on canary first: `kubectl set image deployment/redwood-runtime redwood-runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.4.2 -n inference --record`
Jamal: canary restarted. monitoring.
Ana: also increasing logging verbosity for segfaults to capture core registers: env RUNTIME_DEBUG=segv_capture (will keep for 20m)
incident-bot: Deploy/rollback event by Jamal recorded. Audit link: https://console.internal/tx/rollback/2101234567
Mia: Support update: "We're investigating increased errors affecting generation for some customers. Engineers are mitigating and we will update in 15 minutes." (sent)
Raj: can we prevent noisy restarts while we triage? set backoffLimit in probe to 60s and restartPolicy change? we need to avoid thrashing.
Ana: bumped liveness probe initialDelaySeconds -> 60 on new pods, applied.
Jamal: after canary rollback, canary pods are stable for 6m with no segfaults. Old pods on gpu-23 still crash because node-level driver maybe corrupted.
Ana: action: keep gpu-23 drained and schedule maintenance (reboot + driver reinstall). file ticket to infra-sre.
Leah: moving to incident lead. summary for handoff: root cause suspected: segfault in fused kernel triggered by model variant X quantized op on runtime image v1.5.0 + driver 525.89. Impact: ~300 failed requests, 2 major customers affected. Mitigation taken: cordon/drain gpu-23, canary rollback to v1.4.2, bump probe, temporary autoscale/spare nodes, route fallback. Next steps: infra to reboot node + driver re-image, regression test fused kernels on staging with driver's exact version, and create postmortem if crash confirmed. Assigning infra ticket INF-3472 to Jamal.
Ana: handing off to Leah (incident lead) and Raj for root cause deeper dive. I'm going to keep monitoring for 30m then sign out if stable.
Leah: thanks Ana. @Raj please take model/runtime investigation. @Jamal coordinate node maintenance and driver reimage. @Mia keep customers updated every 30m. I'll update exec channel after 30m or on major change.
Raj: ack. I'll run a binary isolation test and reproduce with a minimized input. uploading gdb core snippet to the incident runbook.
Mia: posted customer update: "Mitigation in progress; fallback in place for affected requests; some requests may get slower results while we stabilize." sent.
incident-bot: oncall-handoff: next on-call in 30m is Raj. Handoff note appended.
Leah: closing active page for now but keeping this thread pinned. If we see reoccurrence, re-open with full pager. :white_check_mark:
